function @flightControl()
	var $pitch = input_number("nav",4)
	var $roll = input_number("nav",5)
	var $fh = $flc.height
	var $fw = $flc.width
	
	if $switches.3
		var $vx = input_number("linv",0)
		var $vy = input_number("linv",1)
		var $vz = input_number("linv",2)
		var $vt = sqrt($vx^2+$vy^2+$vz^2)
		
		if $vz == 0
			$vz = 0.1
		
		var $aoa = -sign($vy)*acos($vz/sqrt($vy^2+$vz^2))
		var $slip = -sign($vx)*acos($vz/sqrt($vx^2+$vz^2))
		
		var $aoaShift = clamp(($aoa/3.14159)*480,-120,120)
		var $slipShift = clamp(($slip/3.14159)*60*3,-60,60)
		
		;aoa
		screen_copy($aoaInd,$flc,0, 200-$aoaShift, 20, 10,80,80)
		screen_copy($aoaShape,$flc,0, 0, 20, 10,80,80)
		$flc.draw_line(60-30*cos($roll*3.14159), 50+30*sin($roll*3.14159), 60+30*cos($roll*3.14159), 50-30*sin($roll*3.14159), yellow )
		$flc.draw_circle(60, 50, 7, yellow )
		;slip
		screen_copy($slipShape,$flc,0, 0, 0, 116,120,21)
		$flc.draw_circle(60+$slipShift, 126, 10, black, black)
		
		$flc.write($fw/2-30,$fh/4+35,white,text("AoA:  {0.00}°", $aoa*180/3.14159))
		$flc.write($fw/2-36,$fh/4+45,white,text("Slip:  {0.00}°", $slip*180/3.14159))
	
	if $switches.4
		;Trim
		if $flc.button_rect(4,$fh-82, 44,$fh-70,0)
			$flc.draw_rect(4,$fh-82, 44,$fh-70, white, white)
			if $trimSW == 0
				$trimSW = 1
			else
				$trimSW = 0
		else
			$flc.draw_rect(4,$fh-82, 44,$fh-70, white, $green * $trimSW)
		;Vert Speed
		if $flc.button_rect(4,$fh-67, 44,$fh-55,0)
			$flc.draw_rect(4,$fh-67, 44,$fh-55, white, white)
			if $pitchSW == 0
				$pitchSW = 1
				$rollSW = 1
			else
				$pitchSW = 0
				$rollSW = 0
		else
			$flc.draw_rect(4,$fh-67, 44,$fh-55, white, $green * $pitchSW)
		
		;up
		if $flc.button_rect(5*$fw/6-10, $fh-90, 5*$fw/6+10, $fh-65, 0)
			$up = 1
			$flc.draw_triangle(5*$fw/6, $fh-90,   5*$fw/6+10, $fh-65,  5*$fw/6-10, $fh-65, $green,$green)
		else
			$up = 0
			$flc.draw_triangle(5*$fw/6, $fh-90,   5*$fw/6+10, $fh-65,  5*$fw/6-10, $fh-65, $green,black)
		;down
		if $flc.button_rect(5*$fw/6-10, $fh-35, 5*$fw/6+10, $fh-60, 0)
			$down = 1
			$flc.draw_triangle(5*$fw/6, $fh-35,  5*$fw/6+10, $fh-60,  5*$fw/6-10, $fh-60, $green,$green)
		else
			$down = 0
			$flc.draw_triangle(5*$fw/6, $fh-35,  5*$fw/6+10, $fh-60,  5*$fw/6-10, $fh-60, $green,black)
		;print(input_number("dash main",7))
		
		;Fine Control
		if $flc.button_rect(7,$fh-35, 40,$fh-12, 0)
			$flc.draw_rect(7,$fh-35, 40,$fh-12, white, white)
			if $fineCtrlSW == 0
				$fineCtrlSW = 1
			else
				$fineCtrlSW = 0
		else
			$flc.draw_rect(7,$fh-35, 40,$fh-12, white, $green * $fineCtrlSW)
		
		$flc.text_size(1)
		$flc.write(12,$fh-33,white,"Fine")
		$flc.write(12,$fh-23,white,"Ctrl")
		
		$flc.write(10,$fh-80,white,text("Trim   {0.000}", $trimSet))
		$flc.write(10,$fh-65,white,"Level")
		
		$pitrol.write(5,5,white,text("P {0.0}°", $pitch*-90))
		$pitrol.write(5,15,white,text("R {0.0}°", $roll*-180))
	
	
	if $switches.3 && $switches.4
		$flc.draw_rect(0,0, $flc.width, $flc.height, white)	
	elseif $switches.4
		$flc.draw_rect(0, $flc.height, $flc.width, $flc.height/2+20, white)
	else	
		$flc.draw_rect(0,0, $flc.width, $flc.height/2+20, white)	
	
function @greader()
	$alt = round(input_number("nav",2))
	var $dens = input_number("dens",0)
	var $h = $gread.height
	var $w = $gread.width
	var $th = $thrust_screen.height
	var $tw = $thrust_screen.width
	var $pitch = input_number("nav",4) * 3.14159/2
	var $roll = input_number("nav",5) * 3.14159
	var $vx = input_number("linv",0)
	var $vy = input_number("linv",1)
	var $vz = input_number("linv",2)
	var $vt = sqrt($vx^2+$vy^2+$vz^2)
	
	if $vz == 0
		$vz = 0.1
	if $dens == 0
		$dens = 0.1
	
	var $ACd0 = 2 * input_number("phys",10) / ($dens * $vz^2)
	var $ACL0 = 2 * input_number("phys",9) / ($dens * $vz^2)
	
	var $fg = 1 / (1 + ($alt)/6200000)^2
	var $thrust = (input_number("thruster1",0) + input_number("thruster2",0)) / (input_number("phys",1)+1) / 9.81
	
	var $drag = 0.5 * $dens * $vt^2 
	
	;print($ACd0, $ACL0)
	
	var $gx = input_number("phys",8); - ($fg * cos($pitch)*sin($roll))
	var $gy = -input_number("phys",9); - ($fg * cos($roll)*cos($pitch))
	var $gz = input_number("phys",10); - ($fg * sin($pitch) ;+ $thrust)
	
	;print($gy)
	var $gt = -sign($gy)*sqrt($gx^2+$gy^2+$gz^2)
	screen_copy($greadShape,$gread,0,0,0,0,$gread.width,$gread.height)
	screen_copy($greadArrow,$gread,0,60+clamp($gy/9*55,-55,55),0,0,$gread.width,$greadArrow.height)
	$gread.write(75,57-clamp($gy/9*55,-55,55),white, text("{0.0}g",$gy))
	
	;if abs($gy) > 20
	;	$reticle.write(55,30,green, "OVER G")
		

function @gear()
	$gearInd.draw_rect(45,60,51,73,$green,$green*(input_number("lgeardoor", 0) > 0));left
	$gearInd.draw_rect(57,55,63,68,$green,$green*(input_number("fgeardoor1", 0) > 0));mid
	$gearInd.draw_rect(69,60,75,73,$green,$green*(input_number("rgeardoor", 0) > 0));right
	
	screen_copy($gearIndShape,$gearInd,0,0,0,0,$gearInd.width,$gearInd.height)
	
	if input_number("nav", 0)>300 && input_number("nav", 3) > 100 && (input_number("lgeardoor", 0) > 0 || input_number("fgeardoor1", 0) > 0 || input_number("rgeardoor", 0) > 0)
		$gearInd.text_size(2)
		$gearInd.write(38,90,red,"GEAR")

function @navball($pitch:number, $roll:number)
	var $w = $ball.width
	var $h = $ball.height
	
	$pitch = 2*$pitch * 90
	$roll = $roll * 180
	
	$ball.blank()
	screen_copy($navball, $ball, 0, 180+$pitch, $w/2-40, 5, 80, 80, -1, $roll)
	screen_copy($navballFrame, $ball, 0, 0, -15, -15, 120, 120)

function @hdg()
	var $h = $headscr.height
	var $w = $headscr.width
	var $hdg = input_number("nav",6) - 180
	
	screen_copy($hdgTicks,$headscr,$hdg-180,0,0,0,$headscr.width,$headscr.height)
	$headscr.draw_triangle(90, 10, 95, 0, 85, 0, cyan,cyan)
	
	
function @altimeter()
	var $h = $altim.height
	var $w = $altim.width
	$alt = input_number("nav",2)
	
	var $vs = input_number("nav",1)
	var $shift = ($alt/1000 - floor($alt/1000))*40
	
	if $vs > 0
		$altim.write(0,$h/2-3,cyan,text("+{0.0}", $vs))
	else
		$altim.write(0,$h/2-3,cyan,text("{0.0}", $vs))
	
	screen_copy($altTicks,$altim,0,60-$shift,0,0,$altim.width,$altim.height)
	$altim.draw_triangle(40,$h/2,30,$h/2-5,30,$h/2+5,cyan,cyan)
	
function @thrust()

	var $tw = $thrust_screen.width
	var $th = $thrust_screen.height 
	
	var $thrust = input_number("throttle", 0)
	
	if $thrust_screen.button_rect(95, 95, 115, 120, 0)
		$maxG = 3
	if $thrust_screen.button_rect(120, 95, 140, 120, 0)
		$maxG = 5
	if $thrust_screen.button_rect(95, 120, 115, 145, 0)
		$maxG = 8
	if $thrust_screen.button_rect(120, 120, 140, 145, 0)
		$maxG = 999
	
	if $maxG == 3
		$thrust_screen.draw_rect(95, 95, 115, 120, $orange);3

function @whichBeac()

	var $bd = 0

	if $q == 0

		if  $ir == 1 && $bd < 8000 && $bz < 5
			output_text("md1", 0, $targetList.$s)
			output_text("md2", 0, $targetList.$s)
			output_text("md3", 0, $targetList.$s)
			output_text("md4", 0, $targetList.$s)

			$reticle.text_size(2)
			$reticle.text_align(center)
			$reticle.write(0,35,green,$targetList.$s)
		else

	elseif time() - $q > 0.2

		$s++

function @reticle()
	var $x = input_number("beac3", 2)
	var $y = input_number("beac3", 3)
	var $z = input_number("beac3", 4)
	var $d = input_number("beac3", 1)
	var $lock = (1+$z)*90 ;in degrees
	var $centerx = $reticle.width/2
	var $centery = $reticle.height/2-20
	
	;Enable/Disable
	if $wingOrd.button_rect(140,4, 172,16,0)

		if $lock_active == 0
			$lock_active = 1

	else

		$wingOrd.write(139,18, $green, "ACTIVE")

	$reticle.draw_circle($centerx,$centery,10,green)

	$reticle.draw_line($centerx+40,$centery-30,$centerx+40,$centery+30,green)
	if $lock_active
		@whichBeac()
	
	;print($lock)

	else

		output_number("buzz1", 0, 0)

var $green = color(10,120,0)
var $radar = screen("dash main", 0)
var $altRadar = screen("dash main", 1)
var $radarSW = 0
var $keyboardSW = 0
var $rangeSW = 1
var $targetSW = 1
var $targetFound = 0
var $scanSW = 1
var $scan = 0
var $tickNum = 0
var $range = 25
var $maxRfov = 15
var $rotate = ".x1{}.y1{}.z1{}.x2{}.y2{}.z2{}.x3{}.y3{}.z3{}"
var $global = ".x{}.y{}.z{}"
var $targetScr = virtualscreen(180,180)
var $radarScr = virtualscreen(180,180)
var $radarScr1 = virtualscreen(180,180)
var $fovScr = virtualscreen(180,270)
var $fovScr1 = virtualscreen(180,270)
storage array $targetList:text
storage array $targetListActive:number
var $dist = 0
var $distVert = 0
var $dir = 0
var $target = ""
var $rEarth = 6203000
var $targetDist : number

function @draw_ellipse($cx:number, $cy:number, $Rx:number, $Ry:number, $n:number)
	if $n == 0
		$n = 20
	var $alpha = 0
	var $x = 0
	var $y = 0
	var $lx = $Rx + $Cx
	var $ly = $Cy
	
	repeat $n ($i)
		$alpha = $i * 2pi / ($n - 1)
		$x = $Rx * cos($alpha) + $Cx
		$y = $Ry * sin($alpha) + $Cy
		
		$fovScr.draw_line($x, $y, $lx, $ly, white)
		$lx = $x
		$ly = $y

function @rot($rol:number,$pit:number,$yaw:number, $xl:number,$yl:number,$zl:number)
	var $cr = cos($rol);
	var $sr = sin($rol);
	var $cp = cos($pit);
	var $sp = sin($pit);
	var $cy = cos($yaw);
	var $sy = sin($yaw);
	
	$global.x = $zl*($cy*$sp*$cr+$sy*$sr)+$yl*($cy*$sp*$sr-$sy*$cr)+$xl*($cy*$cp)
	$global.y = $zl*($sy*$sp*$cr-$cy*$sr)+$yl*($sy*$sp*$sr+$cy*$cr)+$xl*($sy*$cp)
	$global.z = $zl*($cp*$cr)+$yl*($sr*$cp)-$xl*($sp)
	
	;print(atan($global.y,-$global.x)*(180/3.14159),$dist*sqrt($global.x^2+$global.y^2),$dist*$global.z)


function @targetScreen()
	var $size = $targetList.size+1
	var $size2 = $targetList.size

	$radar.draw_rect(0,0, 180, 180, white)
	repeat $size ($u) ;frequency select button
		if $radar.button_rect(0,20*$u,120,20+20*$u, 0) && $u<=$targetList.size
			if $u < $targetList.size
				$radar.draw_rect(0,20*$u,120,20+20*$u, white,yellow)
				$target = $targetList.$u
			else
				if $keyboardSW == 0
					$radar.draw_rect(0,20*$u,180,20+20*$u, white,yellow)
					$keyboardSW = 1
		else
			$radar.draw_rect(0,20*$u,180,20+20*$u, white)
			
	repeat $size2 ($u) ;delete button
		if $radar.button_rect(120,20*$u,180,20+20*$u, 0) && $u<=$targetList.size
			if $u < $targetList.size
				$radar.draw_rect(120,20*$u,180,20+20*$u, white,yellow)
				$targetList.erase($u)
				$scanSW = 1
		else
			$radar.draw_rect(120,20*$u,180,20+20*$u, white)
	foreach $targetList ($ind, $t)
		if $targetListActive.$ind
			$radar.write(10,7+20*$ind,color(255,255,255*($t!=$target)), $t)
		else
			$radar.write(10,7+20*$ind,color(255,255,255*($t!=$target)), $t & " [Not Found]")
		$radar.write(133,7+20*$ind,color(255,255,255), "Delete")
	
	if $keyboardSW;new input
		
		$radar.draw_line(120,0,120,20*$size,white)
		output_number("keys1",0,0.25)
		$radar.write(10,7+20*$targetList.size,color(255,255,255), input_text("keyboard",0))
		$radar.write(138,7+20*$targetList.size,color(255,255,255), "Save")
		$radar.write(132,27+20*$targetList.size,color(255,255,255), "Cancel")
		if $radar.button_rect(120,20*$targetList.size,180,20+20*$targetList.size, 0)
			$radar.draw_rect(120,20*$targetList.size,180,20+20*$targetList.size, white, yellow)
			$keyboardSW = 0
			$targetList.append(input_text("keyboard",0))
			$scanSW = 1
		else
			$radar.draw_rect(120,20*$targetList.size,180,20+20*$targetList.size, white)
		if $radar.button_rect(120,20+20*$targetList.size,180,40+20*$targetList.size, 0)
			$radar.draw_rect(120,20+20*$targetList.size,180,40+20*$targetList.size, white, yellow)
			$keyboardSW = 0
		else
			$radar.draw_rect(120,20+20*$targetList.size,180,40+20*$targetList.size, white)
	else
		$radar.draw_line(120,0,120,20*$targetList.size,white)
		output_number("keys1",0,0)
		$radar.write(10,7+20*$targetList.size,color(255,255,255), "            +")
	
			

function @radar($x:number,$y:number,$z:number, $d:number, $freq:text)
	var $dim = $radar.width/2
	var $dim2 = $radar.width/2-20
	
	var $alt = input_number("nav",2)
	var $roll = -input_number("nav",5)*3.14159
	var $pitch = -(input_number("nav",4))*3.14159/2
	var $yaw = input_number("nav",6)
	
	if $yaw > 180
		$yaw = ($yaw - 360)/180*3.14159
	else 
		$yaw = $yaw/180*3.14159
	
	;print($roll, $pitch, $yaw)
	
	@rot($roll, $pitch, $yaw, -$z,$y, -$x)
	
	$dist = sqrt($global.x^2+$global.y^2)
	
	
	var $b = $d
	var $c = $rEarth + $alt
	var $aAngle = 0
	var $bAngle = 0
	
	$aAngle = acos($global.z)
		
	var$a = sqrt($b^2+$c^2-2*$b*$c*cos($aAngle))
	$distVert = ($a - $rEarth)/1000
	;;print($alt)
	
	if $a != 0
		$bAngle = asin(sin($aAngle)*$b/$a)
	else
		$bAngle = asin(sin($aAngle)*$b/0.00001)
	
	$dist = $c*$bAngle
	
	if $global.x == 0
		$dir = atan($global.y,0.0000001)
	else
		$dir =  atan($global.y,-$global.x)
	
	var $angle = $yaw + $dir-3.14159
	
	$dist = ($dist/1000)
	
	var $shiftx = clamp($dist/$range,0,1)*$dim2*sin($angle)
	var $shifty = -clamp($dist/$range,0,1)*$dim2*cos($angle)
	
	$radarScr1.draw_circle($dim-$shiftx, $dim+$shifty, 2, white)
	$radarScr1.draw_line($dim-$shiftx, $dim+$shifty, $dim, $dim, color(255,255,255*($freq != $target)))
	
	;print($targetListActive.sum, $target, $freq, ($freq != $target))

function @fov_radar($freq:text)
	var $w = $altRadar.width
	var $h = $altRadar.height
	var $scale = ($h-20)/$maxRfov
	var $yaw = input_number("nav",6)
	var $alt = input_number("nav",2)/1000
	
	if $yaw > 180
		$yaw = ($yaw - 360)/180*3.14159
	else 
		$yaw = $yaw/180*3.14159
	
	var $angle = $yaw + $dir -3.14159
	
	var $shiftx = clamp($dist,0,$maxRfov)*$scale*sin($angle)
	var $shifty = clamp($dist,0,$maxRfov)*$scale*cos($angle)
	
	if $distVert-$alt > 0
		$fovScr1.write($w/2-30-$shiftx, $h-12-$shifty, $green, text("+{0.0} ", $distVert-$alt) & $freq)
	else
		$fovScr1.write($w/2-30-$shiftx, $h-12-$shifty, $green, text("{0.0} ", $distVert-$alt) & $freq)
	
	$fovScr1.draw_circle($w/2-$shiftx, $h-20-$shifty, 4, $green, $green)


function @radarShapes()
	var $w = $altRadar.width
	var $h = $altRadar.height
	var $scale = ($h-20)/$maxRfov
	
	$radarScr.blank(0)
	$radarScr.draw_rect(0,0, 180, 180, white)
	$radarScr.draw_circle(90, 90, 70, white)
	$radarScr.draw_circle(90, 90, 70*2/3, white)
	$radarScr.draw_circle(90, 90, 70/3, white)
	$radarScr.write(90-9,90+70/3-12,white, floor($range/3): text & "km")
	$radarScr.write(90-13,90+70*2/3-12,white, floor($range*2/3): text & "km")
	$radarScr.write(90-13,90+70-12,white, floor($range): text & "km")
	
	screen_copy($radarScr,$radar,0, 0, 0, 0,$radar.width,$radar.height)
	screen_copy($radarScr1,$radar,0, 0, 0, 0,$radar.width,$radar.height)
	
	var $theta = 0.6*3.14159;atan(($h-80)/($w/2-40))
	
	screen_copy($fovScr,$altRadar,0, 0, 0, 0,$altRadar.width,$altRadar.height)
	screen_copy($fovScr1,$altRadar,0, 0, 0, 0,$altRadar.width,$altRadar.height)
	$altRadar.draw_triangle($w/2,($h-20)-2*$scale, $w/2-6*$scale*cos($theta), ($h-20)-8*$scale*sin($theta), $w/2+6*$scale*cos($theta), ($h-20)-8*$scale*sin($theta), $green)
	
	$altRadar.write($w/2-18-6*$scale*cos($theta), ($h-20-8)-8*$scale*sin($theta),$green, "8km")
	$altRadar.write($w-40, 55,white, text("{0}km",$maxRfov))
	;$altRadar.draw_circle(90, 180, 150, white)



tick
	if input_number("screenSWs", 2)
		if $radarSW == 0
			$radarSW = 1
		else
			$radarSW = 0
			
	if $radarSW == 0
		output_number("screenSWs", 2,0)
		output_number("keys1",0,0)
	else
		output_number("screenSWs", 2,1)
		
				
	if input_number("info tog",0) && $radarSW
		if $scanSW == 1 && $targetList.size > 0
			$radar.blank()
			if $tickNum == 0
				output_text("beac1",2, $targetList.$scan)
				$tickNum++
			elseif $tickNum == 2
				if $scan == 0
					$targetListActive.clear()
					$targetListActive.fill($targetList.size,0)
				
				$targetListActive.$scan = input_number("beac1",5)
					
				$scan++
				
				if $scan > $targetList.size-1 
					$scanSW = 0
					$scan = 0
					if $target == "" && $targetList.size > 0
						$target = $targetList.0
				$tickNum = 0
			else
				$tickNum++
		else
		
			if $targetSW == 1 ;target selection screen
			
				$radar.blank()
				$radar.write(12,165,white,"Radar")
				@targetScreen()
				if $radar.button_rect(6,175, 50,162, 0)
					$radar.draw_rect(6,175, 50,162, white, white)
					if $targetSW == 1
						$targetSW = 0
						$scanSW = 1
				else
					$radar.draw_rect(6,175, 50,162, yellow)
				
					
			elseif $targetListActive.sum > 0;radar screen
			
				if $tickNum == 0
					output_text("beac1",2, $targetList.$scan)
					$tickNum++
				elseif $tickNum == 2
					$tickNum = 0
					$dist = input_number("beac1",1)
					;print($target,$bogeys.$scan)
					if $targetListActive.$scan
						@radar(input_number("beac1",3),input_number("beac1",2),input_number("beac1",4),input_number("beac1",1),$targetList.$scan)
						@fov_radar($targetList.$scan)
					
						if $targetList.$scan == $target 
							$targetDist = $dist
							$targetFound = input_number("beac1",5)
					$scan++
					if $scan > $targetList.size -1
						$scan = 0
						$radar.blank()
						$altRadar.blank()
						$radar.write(10,8,white, $range:text & "km")
						@radarShapes()
						$radarScr1.blank(0)
						$fovScr1.blank(0)
						if $targetFound 
							if $targetDist < 10
								$radar.write(8,147,yellow,text("{0.0}km", $targetDist))
							else
								$radar.write(8,147,yellow,text("{0}km", $targetDist))
						else
							$radar.write(8,147,yellow,"???")
						$targetFound = 0
						
				
					$radar.text_size(1)
					
					$radar.write(6,165,white,"Target")
					$radar.write(49,165,yellow,$target)
				
				else
					$tickNum++
						
				if $radar.button_rect(4,160, 43,176, 0)
					$radar.draw_rect(4,160, 43,176, white, white)
					if $targetSW == 0
						$targetSW = 1
				else
					$radar.draw_rect(4,160, 43,176, white)
				
				
				if $radar.button_rect(4,4, 45,20, 0)
					$radar.draw_rect(4,4, 45,20, white, yellow)
					if $rangeSW > 4
						$range = 25
						$rangeSW = 1
					else
						$range = $range * 2
						$rangeSW++
				else
					$radar.draw_rect(4,4, 45,20, white)
			else
				$targetSW = 1
				$scanSW = 1			
	else
		$radar.blank()
		$altRadar.blank()
			

	;print($target,$bogeys.$scan)
